info.name: Employee Document Management - Verification Only
info.description: Dedicated collection for the seven employee-document checks. Run Setup first. Uses local seeded accounts by default. Configure file variables and IDs before running. S3 privacy expiry and dependency-failure scenarios require the manual setup described in each folder.

item.name: Setup - Login and upload sample document
item.description: Run in order. This setup creates one test document in S3. Use a non-sensitive sample PDF. Seeded local password is for development only.

exec: pm.test('Admin login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', pm.response.json().data.accessToken);
pm.test('Employee login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('employeeToken', pm.response.json().data.accessToken);
pm.test('Employee profile returns employee ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.employeeId).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('employeeId', pm.response.json().data.employeeId);
pm.test('Upload returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;

pm.test('Response includes safe metadata and download URL', function () { pm.expect(data.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.downloadUrl).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.expiresInSeconds).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('objectKey'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('documentId', data.id);

item.name: 1 - Download URL test
item.description: Generates an authorised URL. The test checks that it is HTTPS and has a short positive expiry. To verify expiration, resend the saved URL after expiresInSeconds; S3 should reject it.

exec: pm.test('Download URL endpoint returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;

pm.test('URL is short-lived HTTPS URL', function () { pm.expect(data.downloadUrl).to.match(/^https:///); pm.expect(data.expiresInSeconds).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(data.expiresInSeconds).to.be.at.most(900); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('downloadUrl', data.downloadUrl);
pm.test('Signed URL downloads the object before expiry', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Document list returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const documents = pm.response.json().data;

pm.test('List contains uploaded document metadata without object keys', function () { pm.expect(documents).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(documents.some((item) => item.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('documentId'))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(documents.every((item) => !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(item, 'objectKey'))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 3 - Invalid file rejection
item.description: Set file paths in collection variables first. Test unsupported extension, invalid signature with an otherwise allowed PDF name/MIME, and file larger than MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE_BYTES.

exec: pm.test('Unsupported extension rejected with 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Invalid content signature rejected with 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Oversized file rejected with 413', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(413); });

item.name: 4 - Authentication and ownership
item.description: Set otherEmployeeId to a real employee UUID that is not the seeded employee, and otherDocumentId to an active document owned by that employee. Out-of-scope access may intentionally return 404 to avoid disclosing records.

exec: pm.test('Missing token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: Reject employee token for another employee documents

exec: pm.test('Out-of-scope employee access is denied', function () { pm.expect([403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Reject employee token for another employee document download

exec: pm.test('Cross-employee document download is denied', function () { pm.expect([403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 5 - Delete and retention
item.description: Delete is a soft delete. Verify metadata is hidden immediately; S3 bytes are expected to remain until UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS and startup cleanup removes them.

exec: pm.test('Delete returns 204', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

item.name: Confirm deleted document no longer has a download URL

exec: pm.test('Soft-deleted document returns 404 for download URL', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

item.name: 6 - S3 privacy
item.description: Signed URL should work only until expiresInSeconds. To check bucket privacy independently, set publicObjectUrl to the direct bucket/object URL copied from AWS Console; unauthenticated direct access should return 403. Do not enable public access to make this test pass.

item.name: Check S3 bucket blocks public object access (manual URL check)

exec: pm.test('Direct anonymous S3 object access is denied', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Check saved signed URL after expiry (run after TTL)

exec: pm.test('Expired signed URL is rejected by S3', function () { pm.expect([400, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 7 - Storage and database failures
item.description: Manual fault-injection only. For S3 failure, temporarily run with an invalid test bucket or deny PutObject in a non-production test IAM policy; expect 503. For DB failure, make S3 available but stop the test DB before upload; expect 500 and verify application logs show cleanup attempt. Restore dependencies after each check. Never run this against production.

item.name: Upload while test S3 is intentionally unavailable

exec: pm.test('Unavailable S3 causes a 503 response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(503); });

item.name: Upload while test database is intentionally unavailable

exec: pm.test('Unavailable database fails safely', function () { pm.expect([500, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
